decisionsTitle: «Cronometrare»: the finish line on «Ziua cursei» — every desk role, the elites first, «Start» at the gun, a press saved at once on the server's clock, the same number twice in the trail, «Clasament»'s decisions kept, «Anulează» for ten minutes and «Istoricul sosirilor» (amending §850)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, from the phone, three days before Saturday's race (2026-11-21), in order:**

1. «pentru ziua cursei am nevoie de o pagina noua pentru cronometrare, practic trebuie sa trec data sosirii pentru fiecare alergator, la elite trec doar prenumele, ca asa sunt trecuti, la resturi trec BIB si asa ii identific» — *for race day I need a new page for timing: I enter each runner's arrival; the elites I enter by the first name alone, as that is how they are written, the rest by the BIB, which is how I identify them.*
2. «vad ca am deja pagina de "clasament" dar trebuie sa mai am un view rapid, in care sa introduc si sa se salveze instant, gen ca a ajuns NR X, Y, Z, etc — elitele trebuie sa fie primii in acest clasament, ei au tratament special — Momentan nu avem "Timp cip" aici, ca e o cursa in care ii trecem pe hartie cum au terminat — deci am nevoie de un mod usor si eficient de a cronometra pentru voluntari» — *a quick view where what I enter saves at once — «number X, Y, Z has arrived» — the elites first, they are treated apart; no chip time here, we also write on paper how they finished; an easy, efficient way for volunteers to time.*
3. Asked four questions, he chose: **the elites** — one button per elite with the bib's label, at the top of the page, before the BIB box, the ranking staying by time (no separate elite ranking); **who** — the desk's volunteers too: every staff role that works the desk records finishes, deletions and corrections staying on «Clasament» with the Organizer and the Administrators; **the start** — a «Start» button an organizer presses at the gun, the editor's «Startul cursei» counting without it; **mistakes** — «Anulează» on the volunteer's own entries for ten minutes, on the page, «Clasament» otherwise.
4. «dar inca un voluntar trece timpul, putem totusi corecta cu delay» — «ca s-ar putea sa ajunga multi deodata» — *another volunteer still writes the times on paper, we can correct later — many may arrive at once.*
5. «cand un voluntar introduce numarul si numele, trebuie sa pun in istorie si numele voluntarului care a facut asta, ca sa putem corecta pe viitor» — *the history must name the volunteer who entered each one, so we can correct later.*
6. «se poate intampla si ca mai multi voluntari sa treaca acelasi numar» — *several volunteers may enter the same number.*

**What was there (§850).** «Sosire», a page under «Clasament» (`/admin/events/[id]/results/sosire`) for the Organizer and the Administrators: one number box and «Sosit», the time since `race_starts_at ?? starts_at` stamped by the server at the request, a number already «Sosit» refused (`RESULT_ALREADY_FINISHED`), no undo (refused: «a wrong press is corrected on «Clasament»»), and a finish button for every staff role refused («the desk Volunteer's line stays the paper sheet, and the owner may widen the role later as a rule change»). Nothing said who pressed what, an elite of the race's list could not be recorded at all (its number is no registration's), and a bunch finish was one round trip per runner.

**Decision — the page (amending BR-REQ-037-08 criterion 24, whose row had three tabs).** «Cronometrare» at `/admin/checkin/cronometrare` (one spelling in both locales), the fourth tab of «Ziua cursei» — «Prezența», «Clasament», «Cronometrare», «Lucruri de adus» — the row `SubNav fits compact`: no glyph below `sm` and the short words «Sosiri» and «Lucruri» there, so the four fit 320 pixels; «Ziua cursei» stays lit in the top nav (the path is under the desk's). The event is the one `?eventId=` names — any race, so «Clasament»'s tab and an old link land on theirs — else the desk's own default; the desk's native select changes it. A group run: the «notRace» alert and nothing else. The old «Sosire» address redirects here with its event (`canRecordFinishes`, a 404 otherwise and for an event that is not there); «Clasament»'s link «Sosire» became «Cronometrare». Words in `Admin.timing.*`; no chip time on the page.

**Decision — who (amending §850's refusal «A finish button for every staff role» and BR-REQ-060-01 criterion 165).** A new predicate, `canRecordFinishes`, defined as `canWorkTheDesk`: every staff role that works the desk — the desk Volunteer, the Redactor, the Organizer, Tehnic, the Administrators — never a member. Asked by the page, by both of a press's actions, the undo's and the clock's question, at each door (`requireStaffCapability`), and again in the service (BR-REQ-060-01); the roles' table test pins it for every role. The page shows what the desk already shows — a number, a name, a time — never an address. «Start», «Clasament» (entering, correcting, deleting, importing, its history) and publishing are unchanged: `canEnterResults`, `canPublishResults`.

**Decision — the gun and «Start».** Two nullable columns, `events.race_gun_at` and `race_gun_by_staff_user_id` (staff_users, `ON DELETE SET NULL`, a CHECK that names nobody without a moment), migration `…_race_gun`, expand only. `results.ts#gunOf` is `raceGunAt ?? raceStartsAt ?? startsAt`, read by the results alone: the public page, the checkpoints' limits, the emails, iCal and the editor keep the planned times; the public read never selects the column, so no public cache is told. «Start» is `canEnterResults`' (`setRaceGun`): the moment is the tap the page claims on the server's clock (`RaceGunPress` writes it into the plain form, on the clock below) when the server hears it at most ten seconds later and it is at most five seconds ahead of the server's own, else the server's — a slow upload at a crowded start line, never the half minute a page whose clock had stopped could carry, every runner's time that much too long; offered and accepted from three hours before the planned gun to six after (`RACE_GUN_WINDOW`), and only while no «Sosit» result is stored (`RACE_GUN_FIXED`) — a second press moves it («Mută startul acum»), «Anulează startul» (asked first) clears it, and after the first finisher the page says the start is fixed. **One tap is one «Start».** The review found «Start» a plain submit with nothing pending: a tap again while the first was still on its way — likely on a slow, crowded start-line network — was queued behind it and sent as a second «Start», which moved the gun to the second tap's moment, or to the server's own when heard more than ten seconds after it: every runner's time short by the gap, beyond repair once the first finisher fixed the gun. Now the button says «Se trimite…» from the tap until the answer and a tap meanwhile is swallowed (`ui/RaceGunPress.tsx`: `useFormStatus`, `aria-disabled` so the focus stays, and the form sending nothing more until then); and the server holds the same line: a «Start» of the organizer whose «Start» the gun stands at, heard at most ten seconds after theirs (`RACE_GUN_REPEAT_MS`, read from the gun's own audit rows: `domain/finish-line.ts#raceGunRepeats`), is answered with the gun as it stands and writes nothing (`?gun=repeat`, «Startul rămâne la …»). Another organizer's press, one after «Anulează startul», and one's own more than ten seconds later move it as before; the move's help says to press more than ten seconds after the first press. One audit row a change, `event.race_gun_set` `{ at, previous }` or `event.race_gun_cleared` `{ previous }`, the instants alone; no email; the event's `version` untouched, so an open editor is not refused for it.

**Decision — a press.** One client island (`results/ui/FinishLine.tsx`) over plain server-rendered forms: with scripts off every button posts and the page comes back saying what happened (`?ok=`, `?dup=`, `?refused=`, `?undone=`, `?gun=`, numbers and codes, never a name), as «Sosire» did.

- **The elites first.** One button an elite, at least 56 pixels (64 drawn), the bib's label large (`eliteBibName`, `eliteLineBibName`, §975) and the full name small under it so two «Andrei» are told apart, ordered by label in Romanian: every confirmed real registration marked «Elită» (its press records its number) and every line of the race's elite list (its press records the line's number). A line, or a marked registration, with no number is drawn disabled with what to do (a number on the elite list, or at «Prezența»; the bib still prints none). An elite already «Sosit» says «✓» and the time and cannot be pressed.
- **An elite line's press** (`recordFinish`'s new case: a number no confirmed registration holds but a line carries) writes a *typed* row — the line's name and number, no sex, no birth date, no agreement to be named — which `hors-concours.ts`' rule 3 ranks, or runs hors concours by the line's «Apare în clasament». Everything else about `recordFinish` is as it was.
- **The box.** The numeric keypad, large, focused; Enter or «Sosit» records; the box is empty at once and keeps the focus.
- **«Prinde timpul»** for a bunch: each press keeps one moment, shown oldest first, each with its ✕; the next number or elite pressed takes the oldest kept moment instead of now.
- **The times.** A press is an instant on the server's clock, read through the phone's **wall clock** (`Date.now()`) and an offset. Not the monotonic `performance.now()`, as the review found: on most phones it stops while the screen is locked, so the first press after a sleep between two finishers — the sparse tail of a race — was stamped early by the sleep, a runner given a better time and place, and «Start» up to its tolerance early. The offset is measured over a round trip as NTP measures one (`domain/finish-line.ts#sampleOfRoundTrip`): the island asks the server's clock as the page wakes (`readFinishClockAction`), again when the page is shown after five minutes away, and every answer carries the server's instants at the request's arrival and at its answer. The better sample is kept (`betterSample`: a measured one over the page's own reading — which is read after every read, but is still late by the page's delivery and old after a back navigation draws the page again from memory —; of two that agree the shorter round trip; of two that disagree, a clock moved, the newer), shared by both islands (`ui/server-clock.ts`) and kept on the phone for half a day, so the next page starts measured. A phone whose clock is wrong, or that slept, stamps right. The server floors the time since the gun to the second, at least one second, and keeps the claimed moment when its time is at least a second, at most its own time since the gun plus five seconds and within `FINISH_WINDOW_MS` (`domain/finish-line.ts#finishStamp`). **A claim before the gun is refused** (`RESULT_FINISH_NOT_STARTED`, the press's line saying the clock's hour to write on paper): the review found it stamped with the server's own time at its arrival, so a press made before the gun and queued on a phone became, when it reached the server, a finisher with a made-up time and place — and fixed the gun. Only a claim ahead of the server's clock (a phone running fast, a runner who has not arrived), or none, takes the server's own time. A queued press sent late keeps the moment the runner crossed — but a press arriving more than a day and three hours after the gun is refused whatever it claims (`FINISH_ARRIVAL_GRACE_MS`): the review found an accepted claim skipped the day's limit, so a queue left on a phone, or a crafted call, could add a finisher to a ranking long published.
- **The queue.** Every press is a line under the box at once («se salvează…») and is sent through the Server Action one at a time, in the order pressed, with its own id (a UUID, `pressId`); an unsent one waits in that phone's `localStorage` for the event (`ui/finish-line-store.ts`, read with `useSyncExternalStore`; every access in a `try`, the page working from memory without it), is retried by itself (two seconds, doubling, every thirty at most, and at `online` or when the page is shown again), and a reload sends what is left. **A second tab of the event writes over nothing**: the review found the line read once per page, so a second tab's next write overwrote the first's waiting presses; now every write reads the storage again first and changes what it finds, and the `storage` event brings another tab's writes into this one — memory is written on as it is only after the storage refused a write, when it is ahead of it. **Presses waiting under another event** — the viewer's own, which only that event's page sends — are named above the box, «2 apăsări așteaptă la <event>» with a link to its page, each line keeping its event's title for that (`waitingElsewhereSnapshot`). **Each press is its account's** (the owner's point 5): it carries the staff id of who pressed it and is sent only from that account's page — the action answers `session` to a press of another account than the session's — so a phone another volunteer signs into shows the earlier one's waiting presses as not sent, with the time to write on paper, and never records them under the new name; the kept moments of «Prinde timpul» are each account's too. A session that ended keeps the presses until the volunteer signs in again. **A press the server answered but could not record** — neither the network nor a rule (`failed`, logged) — stays waiting with its time and is tried again on that backoff, and again, never given up; the presses after it go meanwhile, a later press of its number waiting behind it so the phone's first press of a number is still the first the server hears (`domain/finish-line.ts#nextToSend`, `holdAfterFailure`). The review found it settled «notează pe hârtie» after three answers, about six seconds: a passing database error during a bunch finish — when the database is busiest — turned real presses into paper-only lines. An elite's button waits while its press does, so a double tap is one press. A site deployed again under the page (its Server Actions gone) says to reload, the presses waiting for the reload to send them.
- **Refusals** — a number nobody holds, before the gun, a day after it — stand on the press's own line with the time to write on paper («notează pe hârtie: 0:45:12»), never blocking the box.
- **«Ultimii sosiți»,** the twenty latest written first, refreshed from every answer: the number or the elite's label, the name as the backoffice reads it, the time, the place or «în afara clasamentului», and who entered it («introdus de …», «modificat de …» once changed, «cont șters» for an account gone).
- The pure parts — the clock's samples and which one is kept, the stamp, its bounds and the arrival's grace, what a press does to a stored row, «Start»'s window and tap, the undo's ten minutes and the trail it reads, the kept times, the queue's order and owner, the stored line and the stored clock read back tolerantly — are `results/domain/finish-line.ts`, with unit tests.

**Decision — the same number twice (the owner's point 6).** The first stored wins and nothing about its row changes (`domain/finish-line.ts#pressMeets`). **A retry is the same press, known by its id** (the owner asked that the history be exact): every row of the trail a press writes — `event_result.created`, `.updated`, `.finish_duplicate` — keeps its `pressId`, and a press whose id the trail already holds (the actor's own rows of the race, `results.ts#loadSavedPress`, read under the event's lock before the stamp) is answered as it was the first time — saved, or the number found stored — and writes nothing: an answer lost after the commit, or a second tab sending it too. The review found the retry guessed — the same staff member, the same number, the same floored second —: a lost answer to a duplicate's press wrote a second `finish_duplicate`, «Istoricul sosirilor» showing the press twice, and a press whose claim was refused, retried a second later, became the volunteer's own duplicate and closed their «Anulează». The guess stays only for a press with no id, the plain form with scripts off. Any other press of a number already «Sosit» — another volunteer, or the same one again — is no refusal: its line says «#123 era deja trecut de <name> la <time>», and its own time goes to the trail as `event_result.finish_duplicate` `{ bibNumber, gunTimeMs, storedGunTimeMs, storedStatus, storedResultId, finishLine: true, pressId }`, the actor the trail's own column, so «Istoricul sosirilor» shows both times for the organizers to compare. **A decision of «Clasament» stays the same way.** The review found any stored state but «Sosit» was overwritten by a press — an Organizer's «Descalificat» («a tăiat traseul») turned «Sosit», and first place, by a volunteer's press queued from before it. Now a row «Descalificat» stays whoever presses it and whenever, and so does an «Abandon» or a «Neprezentat» written after the moment the press claims (a press queued on a phone without signal, or a second volunteer's): the press's line says «#123 e trecut «Descalificat» de <name> la «Clasament» — rămâne așa», its time goes to the trail with `storedStatus`, and the history says «rămâne Descalificat». Only an «Abandon» or a «Neprezentat» written before the moment pressed — a runner written off by mistake, who crossed the line — becomes «Sosit», as before. Presses at the same moment wait on the event row's lock (`FOR NO KEY UPDATE`, the first statement of every press) and the unique indexes stand behind it; `tests/concurrency/finish-line.test.ts` holds six volunteers pressing one number at once to one row and five duplicates, and one press sent four times at once to one row and one line of the trail. `RESULT_ALREADY_FINISHED` is gone.

**Decision — «Anulează» (amending §850's refusal «Undo at the line»).** On the viewer's own lines of «Ultimii sosiți», for ten minutes: `undoFinish` deletes a «Sosit» row the acting staff member's **press at the line** wrote — its `event_result.created` carries `finishLine` and the row's id, `resultId` — that nobody changed since — `created_at` = `updated_at`, `updated_by_staff_user_id` the actor, `created_at` within ten minutes (`writeRanking` never touches `updated_at`, so a re-rank is no change) — and **whose number nobody pressed again since** (no `event_result.finish_duplicate` names it, `storedResultId`; `domain/finish-line.ts#undoTrailOf`, read from the last minutes of the trail by the indexed key), ranks the rest again, audits `event_result.deleted` `{ bibNumber, status, gunTimeMs, finishLine: true, undo: true }` and tells the public cache as a delete does. The review found the undo took the row away although another volunteer had pressed the number after it — kept only in the trail — so a volunteer who typed 102 for another runner undid it and left 102, whom a second volunteer had pressed rightly, with no time and nothing on either page flagging it; and that it offered «Anulează» for ten minutes on a row the Organizer had typed on «Clasament». Now a number pressed again since is refused, and the viewer's own line says why instead of «Anulează» («alt voluntar l-a trecut și el după tine…», or «l-ai mai trecut o dată…» for one's own second press: which of the two was right is the organizers' to say); a row typed or imported on «Clasament», one corrected there, a runner written off and turned «Sosit» at the line, another's row and one past ten minutes are refused too (`RESULT_UNDO_NOT_ALLOWED`, a sentence naming «Clasament»); a row already gone is `NOT_FOUND`. No question before it: it undoes a press, and pressing again records the runner again.

**Decision — «Istoricul sosirilor» and who wrote each line (the owner's point 5).** A closed fold on «Clasament» (`canEnterResults`): every write of the race's results — each press at the line (`event_result.created` / `.updated` with `finishLine`), each duplicate with both times — or, for a runner «Clasament» decided, with the decision that stays —, each undo, each «Clasament» save's created, changed (with the boxes) and deleted row, «Start» set, moved and cleared — newest first, one line each: when (to the second), who (the staff display name, «cont șters» for an account gone), what in words with the number and the time, and from where («Cronometrare» or «Clasament»). Read from `audit_logs` (`entity_type = 'event'`, the event's id, the indexed key) left-joined to `staff_users`, as «Istoric capacitate» reads (`results/finish-history.ts` over the pure `domain/finish-history.ts`); the newest four hundred, saying so when there are more. The trail stores a number and never a runner's name; the line adds the name the number belongs to today, read live (`liveNamesByBib`). Each line of «Clasament» says who last wrote it — «introdus de …» while as first written, «modificat de …» once changed — from `updated_by_staff_user_id`.

**Refused.** A separate elite ranking — the owner chose the ranking by time, elites first only on the page. Stamping on `performance.now()` and anchoring once at the page's load — the review's blocker: a locked screen stopped it. Replacing an undone row with the time of the press found after it — the trail does not say which of the two presses was the right one; «Clasament» does, from the history. Turning «Descalificat» into «Sosit» at the line, for any role — the disqualification is the organizers' decision, reversed on «Clasament». A chip time on this page — the owner: none at this race. A second device's kept times on the server — the kept moments are the phone's own, a bunch is timed where it is seen. Typing an elite's name in the box — a name is no key and two «Andrei» would be one; the elite's button is the name. The desk's volunteers editing «Clasament» — corrections and deletes stay the Organizer's and the Administrators', as the owner chose. A question before each press or each undo — a finish line cannot ask before every runner. Settling a press «notează pe hârtie» after a few answers that it could not be recorded — the volunteer has moved on to the next runner, and a passing error is not the runner's. Telling a deliberate «Mută startul acum» within ten seconds of one's own «Start» from the same tap sent twice — the server cannot; the page asks a move to be pressed more than ten seconds later.

**Not done.** The island sending how long a press waited in the queue, for the server to refuse a fresh press whose claim lags its clock — the clock is measured now, and the day's limit holds whatever is claimed. Keeping the desk's roles to the desk's listed races on «Cronometrare» — the day's limit and the decisions that stay cover what a past race could suffer. «Ultimii sosiți» refreshing by itself between presses — it follows every answer and a reload; a timer would be a request a second per phone. Choosing a duplicate's time with one press on «Clasament» — the history shows both, the line is typed by hand. An undo of another volunteer's press, or after ten minutes — «Clasament». Recording a runner no registration and no elite line holds — still refused with the time to write down, typed on «Clasament» later. Naming another account's presses waiting under another event — only the viewer's own are named; another account's stand on their event's page, unsent, with the time to write on paper.
changelogLine: - **«Cronometrare», the finish line on «Ziua cursei»** — a fourth tab where every desk role, the desk Volunteer included, records the finishers: a big button per elite (the bib's label, the name under it), then the bib's number and «Sosit», each press saved at once with its own moment, kept on the phone while there is no signal or the site cannot save it, and kept once however often it is sent; «Prinde timpul» for a bunch; «Start» at the gun for the organizers, one tap one start; a number entered twice keeps the first time and says who had it; «Anulează» on one's own press for ten minutes; «Clasament» says who entered each line and folds «Istoricul sosirilor». The old «Sosire» address leads there. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 193. Given a race, when a staff member whose role works the desk — the desk Volunteer included — opens «Ziua cursei» → «Cronometrare» (`/admin/checkin/cronometrare`, the event named by `?eventId=` — any race — else the desk's default; the old `/admin/events/[id]/results/sosire` redirecting there with its event, and «Clasament» linking it), then it is the fourth of the tabs «Prezența», «Clasament», «Cronometrare», «Lucruri de adus», which fit a 320-pixel phone on their short words, with «Ziua cursei» lit in the top nav, and it draws first a button per elite — every confirmed real registration marked «Elită» and every line of the race's elite list, in the Romanian order of the bib's label, at least 56 pixels tall, the label large and the full name under it, one with no number disabled with what to do, one already «Sosit» with «✓» and its time and not pressable — then the number box on the numeric keypad (Enter or «Sosit»), «Ultimii sosiți» with who entered each line, and no chip time; a group run shows only that it has no results (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/timing-page.test.ts`, `race-day/screens.test.ts`, e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given «Cronometrare», when a number is typed or an elite's button pressed, then the press carries its moment on the server's clock — read through the phone's wall clock and an offset measured over round trips (the clock asked as the page wakes, and every answer carrying the server's instants at the request's arrival and at its answer), so a phone whose clock is wrong or whose screen locked between two finishers stamps the right moment — which the server keeps when its time since the gun, floored to the second, is at least one second, at most the server's own time since the gun plus five seconds and within a day of the gun — a claim before the gun refused as not started, never stamped with the time it arrived at, and only a claim ahead of the server's clock, or none, taking the server's own — the gun being «Start» as pressed, else the race's own start, else the event's; a press arriving more than a day and three hours after the gun is refused whatever it claims; a number no confirmed registration holds but a line of the race's elite list carries is recorded as a typed row with the line's name and number and no sex, birth date or agreement to be named, ranked — or hors concours by the line's «Apare în clasament»; a number neither holds is refused with the time to write on paper, and a press before the gun or more than a day after it is refused, each on the press's own line, never blocking the box (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`.

Given a race number already «Sosit», when it is pressed again — by another volunteer, or by the same one a different second — then the stored row is not changed, the press's line says «#<number> era deja trecut de <staff name> la <time>» («cont șters» for an account gone) and an `event_result.finish_duplicate` audit row records `{ bibNumber, gunTimeMs, storedGunTimeMs, storedStatus, storedResultId, finishLine: true }` and the press's `pressId` under the staff member who pressed; a press sent again with the id the trail keeps for it — its answer lost, or a second tab sending it — is answered as it was the first time, saved or the number found stored, and writes nothing, so «Istoricul sosirilor» shows it once; only a press with no id (the plain form) by the same staff member, of the same number, at the same second is taken for that retry; presses of one number at the same moment on separate connections leave one row and one `event_result.created`, every other press a duplicate; and one press sent several times at once leaves one row and one audit row (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/finish-actions.test.ts`, concurrency `finish-line.test.ts`.

Given a race number whose stored row is «Descalificat», or «Abandon» or «Neprezentat» written after the moment a press claims, when that number is pressed on «Cronometrare» by any role that works the desk — fresh, or queued on a phone and sent late — then the row is not changed, the press's line says the runner is «<state>» and that it stays, the plain form's page says the same (`?dup=…&s=<state>`), and the press's time is written to the trail as an `event_result.finish_duplicate` with that `storedStatus`, «Istoricul sosirilor» saying the decision stays; only an «Abandon» or a «Neprezentat» written before the moment pressed becomes «Sosit» at the stamped time, the note kept (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/finish-actions.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`.

Given a race, when an Organizer or an Administrator presses «Start» on «Cronometrare», then `events.race_gun_at` is set to the tap's moment as the page claimed it on the server's clock when the server hears it at most ten seconds later and it is at most five seconds ahead of the server's own, else to the server's own, with who pressed it; a second press moves it and «Anulează startul», asked first, clears it; both only from three hours before the planned gun to six hours after (`RACE_GUN_WINDOW` otherwise) and only while no «Sosit» result is stored (`RACE_GUN_FIXED` otherwise, the page saying the start is fixed); each change writes one `event.race_gun_set` or `event.race_gun_cleared` audit row with the instants alone; a «Start» of the organizer whose «Start» the gun stands at, heard at most ten seconds after theirs, is answered with the gun as it stands, the page saying it stays (`?gun=repeat`), and writes nothing, and the button says «Se trimite…» while its press is on its way and swallows a tap meanwhile, so a tap is never doubled into a second «Start»; nothing is emailed; the public page, the checkpoints' limits, the emails, iCal and the editor keep the planned times; and the desk Volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member are refused FORBIDDEN (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/finish-actions.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`, `db/race-gun-migration.test.ts`, e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given a «Sosit» row a staff member's own press at the line wrote — its `event_result.created` audit row carrying `finishLine: true` and the row's `resultId` — when that staff member presses its «Anulează» on «Cronometrare» within ten minutes of it being written, while nobody changed it (`created_at` = `updated_at`, `updated_by_staff_user_id` the presser) and while no press of its number came after it (no `event_result.finish_duplicate` naming it), then the row is deleted, the others are ranked again, one `event_result.deleted` audit row records `{ bibNumber, status, gunTimeMs, finishLine: true, undo: true }` and the public cache is told; a row whose number was pressed again since — by another volunteer or by the same one — is refused `RESULT_UNDO_NOT_ALLOWED`, the row kept, and the presser's own line shows instead of «Anulează» that it was pressed again and «Clasament» corrects it; a row typed or imported on «Clasament», another's row, one past ten minutes, one corrected on «Clasament» and a runner written off and turned «Sosit» at the line are refused `RESULT_UNDO_NOT_ALLOWED` with a sentence naming «Clasament», and a row already gone `NOT_FOUND` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/finish-actions.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`, e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given a race's «Clasament», then each line with a stored result says who last wrote it — «introdus de <name>» while the row is as first written, «modificat de <name>» once changed, «cont șters» for an account gone — and a closed fold «Istoricul sosirilor» lists, newest first, from the audit trail joined to the staff accounts, every write of the race's results — each press at the line, each duplicate with both times or with the decision of «Clasament» that stays, each undo, each created, changed and deleted row of a «Clasament» save with the boxes it changed, and «Start» set, moved and cleared — one line each with when, who, what with the number and the time, and from where («Cronometrare» or «Clasament»), the name beside a number read live and never stored in the trail (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-history.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`.

Given «Cronometrare» with scripts on, then every press is a line under the box at once («se salvează…»), the box emptied and still focused; the presses are sent through the Server Action one at a time in the order pressed, each with its own id and by the staff account that pressed it and only from that account's page — another account's press left on the phone shown unsent with the time to write on paper, and the action answering «sign in again» to a press of another account than the session's —, wait in that phone's `localStorage` for the event while unsent (every access in a `try`; without storage the page works and only forgets on a reload), are retried by themselves and sent again after a reload; a press the server answers it could not record stays waiting with its time and is tried again — two seconds, doubling, every thirty at most — never given up, the presses after it sent meanwhile and a later press of its number waiting behind it; a second tab of the same event writes over none of the first tab's presses, the storage read again before every write and another tab's writes followed; the viewer's presses waiting under another event on the phone are named — «N apăsări așteaptă la <event>», with a link to its page —; an elite's button waits while its press does; a site deployed again under the page says to reload, the presses waiting; «Prinde timpul» keeps one moment a press, each account its own, oldest first, each with its ✕, and the next number or elite pressed takes the oldest kept moment instead of now; a session that ended keeps the presses until the volunteer signs in again; and with scripts off each box and button posts a plain form and the page comes back saying what happened (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`, `results/finish-line-store.test.ts`, integration `results/finish-actions.test.ts`, concurrency `finish-line.test.ts`, e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Amends criterion 165. Given a race's finish line, when a staff member of any role that works the desk — the desk Volunteer, the Redactor, the Organizer, Tehnic, the Administrators — opens «Cronometrare», records a finish, asks the server's clock or undoes their own press, then the page, the actions and the service allow it (`canRecordFinishes`, defined as `canWorkTheDesk`), and a member gets the page's 404 and the actions' and the service's FORBIDDEN; «Start», «Istoricul sosirilor» and «Clasament» — entering, correcting, deleting, importing and reading — stay the Organizer's and the Administrators', and publishing the Administrators', as criterion 165 says (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `staff/roles.test.ts`, integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/finish-actions.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`.

Amends criterion 24. Given «Ziua cursei», when any of its pages is drawn — the desk, «Lucruri de adus», «Cronometrare» or a race's «Clasament» — then four tabs stand at its top, «Prezența», «Clasament», «Cronometrare» and «Lucruri de adus», the current one marked (`aria-current`), each link carrying the chosen event, never printed, and below the `sm` width drawn without glyphs and on their short words («Sosiri», «Lucruri») so the four fit a 320-pixel phone; «Clasament» is not drawn without an event or for a role that cannot open the results, «Cronometrare» is drawn for every role that works the desk, the old «Sosire» address `/admin/events/[id]/results/sosire` redirects to «Cronometrare» with its event, and the desk's rows and verbs are as before (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `race-day/screens.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`, unit `shared/sub-nav.test.ts`, e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.
